description: This file defines the LogicExpression interface used internally in the OpenMRS logic service to represent logical criteria as either binary or unary expressions. It includes method signatures for retrieving operators, root tokens, operands, and transformations, facilitating the construction and processing of logical expressions within the system.

classes.name: LogicExpression
classes.description: An interface representing logical expressions (either unary or binary) used internally within the OpenMRS logic service to form and process criteria for querying.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator associated with this logical expression.

methods.name: getRootToken
methods.description: Returns the root token of the logical expression, typically used to identify or categorize the expression.

methods.name: getRightOperand
methods.description: Returns the right operand of the logical expression, applicable for both unary and binary forms.

methods.name: getTransform
methods.description: Returns the transformation applied to the logical expression, encapsulated as a LogicTransform object.

methods.name: setTransform
methods.description: Sets the transformation expression applied to this logical expression.
